title: MRO CTX visible mosaic (6 m)
credit: NASA/JPL/MSSS/USGS (MRO CTX via JPL Mars Trek)
note: Greyscale relative brightness, uncalibrated. A 2048 px version is ctx_2048.jpg.

title: THEMIS daytime infrared mosaic (100 m)
credit: NASA/JPL/ASU (Mars Odyssey THEMIS via JPL Mars Trek)
note: Relative brightness (8-bit), not calibrated temperature. Coarse: ~100 m/px, about 5x coarser than the DEM.

title: THEMIS nighttime infrared mosaic (100 m)
credit: NASA/JPL/ASU (Mars Odyssey THEMIS via JPL Mars Trek)
note: Relative brightness (8-bit), not calibrated temperature. Brighter generally means warmer at night; this is a qualitative thermal-inertia cue only.

title: Geologic units (Sun & Stack 2020, 1:75,000)
mission: Mars 2020 landing-site mapping (map compiled on MRO CTX/HiRISE imagery)
note: Index raster (R = unitOrder index + 1, 0 = unmapped); vector polygons in geology.json. Display colours are this project's own, not USGS colours.

title: Slope (derived from the CTX DEM)
credit: NASA/JPL/MSSS/USGS (MRO CTX via JPL Mars Trek)
note: Computed client-side from dem.i16 at 20 m posting; slope over a 20 m baseline.

title: Perseverance traverse waypoints
note: Vector layer. Continuous drive path in traverse_path.json (Mars Trek Perseverance_Traverse_Path).

title: Mars 2020 landing ellipse
note: Vector rings stored in the `ellipse` field of geology.json.
